Why a website? Why Jolly Panda? What if I skip it?
Scroll
Question 1

Why does my business need a website?

Because that's where people look first — and where you get to tell your own story.

Open 24/7

Your website answers questions, shows your work and collects inquiries while you sleep.

People search before they call

Customers look you up online first. A website is what they find.

It builds trust

Your own address and a clean design tell visitors you're a real, established business.

You own it

Social pages can change their rules or reach overnight. Your website stays yours.

It brings new customers

Be found on search engines by people who are already looking for what you offer.

You can measure it

See who visits, what they read and where they get stuck — then improve.

Question 2

What happens if I don't have one?

Nothing dramatic — you just quietly lose opportunities every day.

Without a website

  • Customers who search for you find nothing — or find your competitor.
  • You look less established than the businesses that do have one.
  • You depend on platforms whose rules and reach can change anytime.
  • Every price, address and question has to be answered by hand.
  • You can't tell what's working, so you can't improve it.

With a website

  • People find you on search engines, at any hour of the day.
  • You look professional from the very first click.
  • You own your audience and your story.
  • Answers, prices and contact details are always one click away.
  • You see real numbers and make better decisions.
Question 3

Why build it with Jolly Panda?

Six things you get when you work with us.

Design and code, one team

The people who design your site are the people who build it — no hand-offs, no lost details.

Clear prices from the start

Starting prices for every plan are published in US dollars. The final price is set together in a consultation.

Mobile-ready and secure

Every plan includes responsive design for phones and tablets, plus an SSL certificate.

Support after launch

From 1 month of support on Economy to 6 months of priority support on Custom.

Persian and English, RTL and LTR

We build bilingual, right-to-left-ready sites every day — this very website is one.

Built for speed and search

Light, fast pages with clean structure, so visitors stay and search engines understand you.

Question 4

How is a website made?

No jargon, no mystery. Four steps from a first chat to a live website.

  1. 1

    Consultation

    You tell us about your business and goals. Together we settle on the plan and the final price.

  2. 2

    Design

    A customized template or a fully custom interface — depending on your plan.

  3. 3

    Build

    We build the pages and features, optimize speed and SEO, and test on phone, tablet and desktop.

  4. 4

    Launch & support

    Your site goes live, and we stay available for the support period included in your plan.

  • Every plan includes responsive design (mobile and tablet) and an SSL certificate.
  • Domain and hosting costs are charged separately from the plans.
